Name: Pokemon Trinkets
Author: XanCreations
Description:
[center][color=#00ccff][size=5][b]Pokémon Trinkets[/b][/size]
[size=2][i]By XanCreations[/i][/size][/color]

Version: 1.0.0
Compatibility: Stardew Valley [1.6+] • TrinketTinker (version 1.6.4+ req.)[/center]


[b][color=#00ccff]Description:[/color][/b]
Adds 18 Pokémon as Trinkets to the list of available Trinkets that can drop from defeating monsters and destroying crates.
These are the same Trinkets from my Catchable Pokémon mod, however, I realised that perhaps not everyone wants to go through a progression system to unlock the Trinkets or perhaps they don't want to catch the Pokémon either. So this is for everyone who just wants some nice looking Trinkets that help them on their adventure in the Valley.

[color=#00ccff][b]How to get Trinkets:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Defeat monsters or destroy crates -> It's the same as how you get Trinkets normally.
[*]When you run this mod for the first time it generates a config file which allows you to have the trinket slot straight away without needing combat mastery. You can disable this if you prefer, but otherwise you should start getting these trinkets straight away.
[/list]
[color=#00ccff][b]How to upgrade Trinkets:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]When you get to Level 8 Mining, you will get the recipe to craft the "PokéTrinket Device".
[*]When you put a Pokemon into this device, it upgrades them by one level.
[*]At this stage there are two types of Pokemon: One that buffs the player's stats and follows you around and the other which attacks enemies and does combat alongside you.
[*]Of the 18 Pokemon, 14 of those are buffs and 4 of them are combat. Keep in mind the combat Pokemon take longer to make, hence why there are more buff Pokemon.
[/list][list]
[*]Buff Pokemon have only 2 levels. Combat Pokemon have 3 levels. When the Pokemon reach their maximum level, the device won't upgrade them further.
[*]The upgrade cost is 10 gold bars, instead of the usual 3 iridium bar cost. You can, if you prefer, use the regular Anvil with Iridium bars, but the level will be random.
[/list]
[color=#00ccff][b]You can make Pokémon into Shiny variants:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]If you want to make a Pokemon into a shiny variant or turn it back to it's non-shiny form, you can use the Trinket Colorizer. You can buy this from the Clint for 50 Gold Bars once the Anvil recipe is obtained.
[*]It costs 20 Omni Geodes to change the Pokemon variant in the Trinket Colorizer.
[/list]

[color=#00ccff][b]Recommended Mods:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - This makes it much easier to visualize and use the configs.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39663]Trinket Drop Chance Config[/url] - I created this so it is easier to configure Trinket drop chances and disable Vanilla trinkets if you prefer.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url] - There is a setting in the config that allows an extra Trinket slot. You could have two Pokemon follow you around -> I tested this and it works perfectly. It kind of reminds me of Pokemon Mystery Dungeon. NOTE: Buffs don't stack if they are the same value (for example Magikarp and Psyduck both have fishing 1, equipping both still only gives Fishing 1. But Psyduck level 2 gives Fishing 2. Combined with Magikarp gives Fishing 3.
[/list]
[b][u]I would not recommend using this with my Catchable Pokemon mod.
[/u][/b]The trinkets here are already in my Catchable Pokemon mod, they just have different IDs and are obtained differently.
They should be compatible, it just would make it hard to know which trinket/upgrade machine comes from which mod since they look identical.


[color=#00ccff][b]Installation:[/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker[/url].
[*]Copy the PokemonTrinkets folder into your ‘Mods’ directory:
[code]StardewValley\Mods\PokemonTrinkets
[/code]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI.
[/list]

[color=#00ccff][b]Configuration:[/b][/color]
I recommend getting [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39663]Trinket Drop Chance Config[/url].
This mod gives you a Trinket Slot early by default so you can start getting these Trinkets straight away. But if you don't want that, you will need to disable this in the config and reload the game. However, if you like having the Trinket slot early but don't want Trinkets dropping too much, then use Trinket Drop Chance Config to reduce or turn off Trinket drops completely until you want Trinket Drops. This is one of the reasons I made it :)
